name: Vcell Mode
meaning: Real cells = 1, 2, 3 and 16 (bit n = cell n+1). The other inputs are shorted together and are ignored.
notes: TRM SLUUBY2B 13.3.2.19. Board wiring: VC3..VC15 tied to the top of cell 3, VC16 = top of cell 4.

name: COV Threshold
meaning: Cell overvoltage trip = 84 x 50.6 mV = 4250.4 mV
notes: Owner window maximum 4250 mV. The permanent-fail SOV (4500 mV) stays above it.

name: CUV Threshold
meaning: Cell undervoltage trip = 65 x 50.6 mV = 3289.0 mV
notes: Owner window minimum 3250 mV. The permanent-fail SUV (2200 mV) stays below it.

name: Enabled Protections A
meaning: Bit7 SCD + bit3 COV + bit2 CUV enabled (power-up default 0x88)
notes: OCD1/OCD2/OCC and all temperature protections stay OFF (no thermistors attached yet).

name: SCD Threshold
meaning: Index 0 = 10 mV = 10 A at the 1 mOhm sense resistor

name: SCD Delay
meaning: 14 counts = about 195-210 us (library: ~15 us per count; valid 1-31)
notes: Delay sweep at 10 A with the load: raw 11 was the smallest value that passed 3 of 3; 14 adds margin. DECISION POINT: change here if you want a different margin.

name: FET Options
meaning: Power-up default 0x0D plus bit 4 (PDSG_EN): pre-discharge before DSG closes
notes: Bit naming from the BQ76952 library comment on 0x1D.

name: Predischarge Timeout
meaning: 50 x 10 ms = 500 ms; DSG is forced on when this expires
notes: Pre-discharge is timing-only because the Stop Delta below is 0.

name: Predischarge Stop Delta
meaning: 0 = voltage check disabled (LD is measured upstream of the ideal diodes and cannot see the pre-charge)
